# Firmware third-party notices

`esp-idf-5.5.4/` preserves license and notice files from the SDK linked into the
production `esp32c6usb` image (pinned pioarduino 55.03.39, ESP-IDF 5.5.4):
ESP-IDF, Espressif Wi-Fi/PHY/coexistence libraries, FreeRTOS, lwIP, Mbed TLS,
newlib/picolibc, WPA supplicant, and micro-ecc (bootloader). Bluetooth is not linked.
Paths mirror the SDK tree. These notices cover their respective dependencies;
they do not assign a license to this project's own source.

SDK source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/tree/v5.5.4
